decision: Adopt the reframe to an 'Experience Readiness Gate' with two first-class consumer families (human, agent). The gate asks 'can each intended consumer complete their journey with evidence matching their surface?' Grounding confirmed current DontPanic does NOT differentiate: agent/MCP is one flat advisory surface class, there is zero agent-surface evidence capture, and nothing checks cross-surface agreement or per-family degraded honesty.
rationale: Agent traffic (API/MCP/CLI) is product UX; a human-browser-centric gate re-encodes the blind spot the critique identified.

decision: Build the agent-surface evidence class FIRST and dogfood it (CLI transcript, in-process MCP tool-call transcript, schema/contract check) reusing runtime_evidence/harness.py Protocol composition.
rationale: DontPanic cannot execute most human surfaces in its own loop but CAN execute agent surfaces; building the executable half first proves the typing+enforcement rules end-to-end without a project toolchain.

decision: The QuantRE Product Readiness and Honesty Gate (route inventory, persona journeys, maps/API availability, appraisal/export, persona signoff) is a SEPARATE consumer-side plan authored in QuantRE's repo against this capability -- NOT DontPanic core features. DontPanic governs/verifies evidence; QuantRE's toolchain executes its human surfaces.
rationale: Governs-not-executes + plans-vs-operator-actions: project-specific human-surface execution lives in the project; the reusable typing/enforcement capability lives in DontPanic.

decision: Reuse, don't duplicate: extend objective_contract UserJourney, EvidenceRef, the runtime-evidence harness, completion_auditor, and the render-truth/missing_extractor degradation pattern. No parallel readiness model or second harness.
rationale: The substrate is mature; the gap is consumer-family typing + agent evidence class + agreement + close-time enforcement on top.

decision: Define the readiness evidence vocabulary as a NEW optional evidence_class field on EvidenceRef (plus a data_provenance field), NOT by inventing new EvidenceRef.type enum values. Each evidence_class maps to a valid existing type (e.g. tool_call_transcript->log, contract_check->test_output, screenshot->screenshot). A test asserts the 8 existing type values are unchanged.
rationale: Lock-review: 'don't invent names the schema can't carry.' The existing EvidenceRef.type enum is the storage contract; evidence_class is a deliberate additive discriminator the typing rule keys on, so the schema stays intact and round-trippable.

decision: Add a data_provenance marker (seeded|real|degraded) to EvidenceRef. Seeded evidence does NOT satisfy a consumer-readiness claim unless the journey is explicitly fixture_only (emits seeded_masks_readiness otherwise).
rationale: The QuantRE failure hinged on seeded fixtures masking product-data emptiness; without a provenance marker the gate would accept a rendered fixture as proof of product readiness.

decision: A typed-skip EvidenceRef counts as evidence of honest unavailability (supporting an allowed degraded mode), NEVER as a satisfying consumer-surface capture. A journey 'covered' only by typed-skips is not satisfied and, on a product-class plan, blocks at close.
rationale: Lock-review: typed skip must prove honest degradation, not journey success; otherwise a plan could 'pass' by skipping every real capture.

decision: Cross-surface agreement compares structured capability-availability/provenance claims keyed by a shared data_source key (e.g. capability id) carried on required_data_sources, NOT prose. Disagreement on the same key yields cross_surface_disagreement.
rationale: Lock-review: prose comparison is unreliable; a shared structured key lets the checker prove the human UI and agent API make the same availability/provenance claim about the same source.

decision: Alignment with the merged Agent Channel Interop v0 surfaces (plan 2026-06-14-001, main da48bb3): (1) cli_agent / mcp_tool are EVIDENCE/CONSUMER surfaces (where a consumer journey runs), NOT operator_surfaces (which identify how an operator drives DontPanic) — the two axes stay distinct. (2) When this plan needs an agent/runtime id it normalizes through Plan 1's invocation_context.normalize_identifier and the canonical agent_runtime id set {claude,codex,gemini,grok,cursor,antigravity,opencode,aider,unknown_runtime}. (3) When it needs an operator/app surface id it uses Plan 1's operator_surface id set {terminal,codex_app,claude_desktop,claude_dispatch,antigravity,cursor,github_agent_hq,remote_vm,github_vm,unknown_surface}. (4) When it needs a data-source or capability key (F004/D009 required_data_sources, cross_surface_disagreement) it uses the existing capability-manifest id space (Plan 1 F008) where applicable. (5) consumer-family values {human,agent,both} (F001) are CROSS-REFERENCED to, but NOT conflated with, Plan 1's operator-role value domain (D015: union{agent_runtime ids, operator_surface ids, human, unknown_role}) — readiness consumer family is a journey property, operator role is a preference/intent; they share the human/agent vocabulary but are not the same field.
rationale: Re-review after Plan 1 merged: prevents a third parallel vocabulary forming around agent surfaces and capability/data-source keys, and reduces avoidable lock-audit churn by reusing the canonical normalize_identifier id spaces instead of minting new ones. Operator-directed at the post-merge re-review (2026-06-15).

decision: Pin evidence_class as a SINGLE CLOSED enum defined once in F001 and referenced by F002/F003/F004 — human {screenshot,recording,journey_walk,terminal_transcript,rubric,human_signoff}, agent {tool_call_transcript,cli_transcript,contract_check}, mutation {idempotency,rollback}, structured {structured_error}. Reconcile the prior F002/F003 drift: contract_check (not contract_test); terminal_transcript = cli_human (human) is distinct from cli_transcript = agent CLI.
rationale: Sufficiency finding (high): the vocabulary was open/inconsistent across F002 vs F003, so captured agent evidence could fail the checker. A closed shared enum makes typing total and the checker decidable.

decision: F004 keyed cross-surface comparison + capability_unavailable read STRUCTURED EvidenceRef fields, not prose: F001 adds data_source (key) + availability (available|unavailable) to EvidenceRef; an agent capability_unavailable IS an agent EvidenceRef {data_source, availability=unavailable}; an honest human label IS a human EvidenceRef {data_source, availability=unavailable}; cross_surface_disagreement compares {availability, data_provenance} per data_source key.
rationale: Sufficiency finding (critical): F004 named required_data_sources but never said WHERE structured availability/provenance live, leaving keyed comparison underspecified. Locating them on EvidenceRef makes the checker pure + structural.

decision: required_evidence_classes takes (surface_class, consumer, claim_kind) where claim_kind in {read_only, mutation, qualitative}. claim_kind is a SEPARATE dimension from surface_class because mutation and qualitative are claim kinds (not surfaces) and can share a surface with read-only claims; mutation adds {idempotency,rollback} atop the surface/consumer base.
rationale: Sufficiency finding (high): the prior signature collapsed surface/consumer/claim-kind, conflating mutation/qualitative with surface classes.

decision: Typed-skip representation stays within the schema: a typed-skip EvidenceRef is availability=unavailable + data_provenance=degraded — data_provenance is NOT extended with a 'skipped' value. F003 emits typed-skips this way; F004 detects honest unavailability by availability=unavailable.
rationale: Sufficiency finding (medium): F003 implied a skip marker / extra provenance value that F001's {seeded,real,degraded} enum did not permit; representing skip via the structured availability field keeps the enum closed.

decision: Round-2 sufficiency: pin a CLOSED surface_class enum {read_only_ui, interactive_ui, mobile_app, cli_human, agent_mcp_tool, cli_agent, external_integration, service_batch} derived from the 8 qa-sufficiency classes; the legacy 'mutation' class is modeled as claim_kind=mutation (D014), NOT a surface; document the legacy-8 + journey.surfaces-token -> surface_class mapping; unknown surface_class rejected.
rationale: Finding (high): surface taxonomy was non-deterministic — F001 referenced the 8 classes loosely while F002 used cli_human/mcp_tool/api unpinned. Closing the enum + reconciling mutation removes implementer ambiguity.

decision: Round-2 sufficiency: define explicit set semantics for required_evidence_classes output — result is a list of conjunctive GROUPS; within a group 'a|b|c' means at-least-one-of; all groups must be satisfied. e.g. agent_mcp_tool -> [{tool_call_transcript|contract_check},{structured_error}].
rationale: Finding (high): 'screenshot|recording|journey_walk' and 'tool_call_transcript|contract_check, structured_error' were ambiguous (all? any? fallback?). Group/alternative semantics make the checker deterministic.

decision: Round-2 sufficiency: the typed-skip vs honest-in-journey-degradation distinction is at the journey EVIDENCE-SET level, not the EvidenceRef tuple. The same {availability=unavailable, data_provenance=degraded} ref is honest-unavailability either way; a journey is satisfied only if its evidence set ALSO contains a real (non-seeded) journey-EXECUTION EvidenceRef. A set of only unavailable/typed-skip refs is unsatisfied.
rationale: Finding (medium): typed-skip and honest capability-unavailable share the same tuple yet require different close outcomes; the discriminator is the presence of a real execution capture in the set, not the tuple.

decision: SPLIT (operator decision 2026-06-15): the Experience Readiness Gate is split into this typing/evidence layer (2a) and a close-time enforcement layer (sibling plan 2026-06-15-002, 2b). 2a defines vocabulary + captures the right evidence; 2b decides when completion is blocked/deferred/dispositioned. 2b stays draft and does not lock until 2a is merged so enforcement consumes a stable vocabulary.
rationale: Round-3 sufficiency surfaced repeated new high/critical conceptual layers in the enforcement matrix while the typing layer had converged; forcing both through one paid loop was the churn source. Separate capabilities, separate plans.

decision: Round-3 typing fix: CONSUMER x SURFACE validation — consumer=human requires >=1 human-family surface, consumer=agent >=1 agent-family surface, consumer=both >=1 of EACH; a mismatch is rejected at declaration so required-evidence derivation is unambiguous.
rationale: Finding (high): the family mapping existed but nothing validated declared consumer against declared surfaces, leaving evidence derivation ambiguous (e.g. consumer=both with only a human surface).

decision: Round-3 typing fix: EvidenceRef.availability may be set ONLY together with data_source — an availability without a data_source key is rejected (Pydantic validator).
rationale: Finding (medium): F004 keyed comparison depends on data_source, but availability was independently optional; an unavailable ref without a key cannot prove honest degradation or participate in cross-surface agreement.

decision: Round-3 typing fix: agent_mcp_tool read_only SUCCESS is satisfied by a tool-call OR contract transcript alone; structured_error is required ONLY for a degraded/error-path claim, not unconditionally conjunctive.
rationale: Finding (high): requiring structured_error alongside every transcript conflicted with the journey promise that a successful tool-call/contract transcript satisfies the claim.

decision: Round-3 typing fix: a typed-skip carries its operator-readable reason in EvidenceRef.note AND, for transcript/log sources, the same reason in the artifact body; the reason location is explicit and asserted in tests.
rationale: Finding (medium): F003 required a reason but did not pin where it lives, risking structurally-valid but operationally-opaque silent skips.

decision: Round-1 (2a) fix: consumer is REQUIRED on any journey asserting a consumer-facing outcome; omission is rejected (not silently optional) so typing + consumer-surface validation cannot be bypassed.
rationale: Finding (high): optional consumer let a consumer-facing claim skip typing before enforcement ever saw stable vocabulary.

decision: Round-1 (2a) fix: fixture_only has an explicit DEFAULT of false; seeded_masks_readiness is deterministic for older/partially-authored journeys.
rationale: Finding (medium): unspecified fixture_only default made the seeded rule nondeterministic.

decision: Round-1 (2a) fix: journey-level aggregation — required evidence is the union of per-(surface, claim_kind) groups across all declared surfaces; consumer=both requires >=1 human-surface requirement AND >=1 agent-surface requirement satisfied together.
rationale: Finding (high): the typing fn was per-surface_class but journeys declare multiple surfaces + consumer=both with no pinned aggregation.

decision: Round-1 (2a) fix: claim_kind is extended to {read_only, mutation, qualitative, error_path}; structured_error is required iff claim_kind=error_path — a pinned input tells the pure typing rule when an error path is evaluated.
rationale: Finding (medium): structured_error depended on an 'error-path' notion with no pinned input field in the closed claim_kind set.

decision: Round-1 (2a) fix: mutation maps to TWO separate conjunctive groups [{idempotency},{rollback}] — both required; the requirement-expression example is disambiguated from an alternatives reading.
rationale: Finding (medium): the mutation notation was ambiguous (both-required vs alternatives vs malformed grouping).

decision: Round-1 (2a) fix (CRITICAL): degraded_dishonest is evaluated PER REQUIRED FAMILY — each consumer_family the journey requires for a data_source must carry its own honest availability=unavailable signal; one family masking while another degrades is dishonest. The prior 'neither family' rule let one family silently omit its degraded signal.
rationale: Finding (critical): the journey requires BOTH families to degrade honestly, but the checker only fired when NEITHER family signalled, allowing masking.

decision: Round-1 (2a) fix: EvidenceRef gains an explicit consumer_family (human|agent) attribution field; F004 cross-family comparison reads it directly instead of inferring family from evidence_class (which breaks for shared classes like structured_error).
rationale: Finding (high): the checker compared families by data_source but EvidenceRef had no family attribution; evidence_class inference is underspecified for shared classes.

decision: Round-1 (2a) fix: the honesty checker CONSUMES allowed_degraded_modes — a degraded EvidenceRef is honest only if its mode is listed for that data_source; an unlisted degraded mode is degraded_dishonest. The contract field now has a behavioral effect.
rationale: Finding (medium): allowed_degraded_modes was an accepted schema field with no defined checker behavior.

decision: Round-1 (2a) fix: the F003 CLI transcript adapter runs a pinned NON-INTERACTIVE read-only command under a fixture/offline env guard (no network, no paid external execution); the command contract (argv + exit code + stdout schema) is fixed and asserted.
rationale: Finding (medium): 'non-interactive, no live paid call' was stated but the command contract / fixture mode / env guard preventing accidental paid execution was unpinned.

decision: Round-1 (2a) fix: remove the F002 'close gate (F005) decides blocking' reference — close-time blocking is out of scope for 2a; the sibling enforcement plan 2b consumes this typing result. Keeps 2a's objective contract free of an out-of-scope implementation target.
rationale: Finding (medium): F002 referenced close gate F005 even though enforcement is delegated to 2b, creating an out-of-scope target.

decision: Round-2 (2a) fix: F002 satisfaction and F004 SHARE one exclusion rule — an availability=unavailable (typed-skip) EvidenceRef never counts as a satisfying consumer-surface capture even if its evidence_class matches.
rationale: Finding (high): F002 matched by evidence_class+provenance while F004 said typed-skips never satisfy; without a shared rule a degraded typed-skip could be counted satisfied by the typing checker.

decision: Round-2 (2a) fix: EvidenceRef gains degraded_mode (str) naming the SELECTED degraded mode; required when the ref represents a degraded data_source, so F004 validates structurally against allowed_degraded_modes.
rationale: Finding (high): allowed_degraded_modes had no structured EvidenceRef field carrying the chosen mode, forcing prose inference.

decision: Round-2 (2a) fix: consumer_family is REQUIRED whenever availability is set (validator rejects availability without data_source AND consumer_family).
rationale: Finding (high): consumer_family was optional but F004 per-family degradation + cross-family agreement depend on it; omission breaks the proof.

decision: Round-2 (2a) fix: the read_only required-evidence matrix is TOTAL over the closed surface_class enum (read_only_ui, interactive_ui, mobile_app, cli_human, cli_agent, agent_mcp_tool, external_integration, service_batch all pinned); a test asserts every member has a defined requirement.
rationale: Finding (medium): the matrix was only partially pinned (interactive_ui/mobile_app/external_integration/service_batch undefined).

decision: Round-2 (2a) fix: the MCP dogfood adapter invokes tools/list + the PINNED read-only tool `status` (deterministic), not an open-ended 'e.g. list_projects or status'.
rationale: Finding (medium): leaving the second tool as an example made the harness fixture depend on whatever tool happened to exist, weakening determinism.

decision: Round-2 (2a) fix: F004 requires only a MINIMAL additive human-compatibility path — existing human EvidenceRefs populate the new structured fields (data_source/availability/consumer_family/degraded_mode); NOT a rebuild of human-surface capture (which stays a non-goal). A test asserts a human unavailable-label ref with those fields is consumed.
rationale: Finding (medium): F004 needed structured human unavailable labels but the non-goal excludes rebuilding human capture, with no compatibility path specified.

decision: Round-3 (2a-core) pin: the no-secret-shaped-field assertion covers ALL THREE agent adapters (CLI, MCP, contract), not only the MCP path.
